lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦後の、本気で、絶対、浩二、絶対、さんの、絶対、回想録、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, your paper on postwar memoirs—Koji-san's in particular—was genuinely impressive.
lines.style: Warm, measured approval. Slight pause before the dash, as if drawing his full attention. Steady, genuine tone—not effusive, but clearly sincere. The kind of teacher who means what she says.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。歴史家の、本気で、絶対、嶋、絶対、先生の、絶対、研究、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I leaned heavily on Shima-sensei's historical research—it gave my work real depth.
lines.style: Respectful, earnest. Quick breath before the acknowledgment, as if wanting to credit his source properly. Modest but not self-effacing. The careful gratitude of someone who takes his intellectual debts seriously.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 歴史的事件の、本気で、絶対、死因、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: The way you handled the causes behind historical events—the breadth of perspective was really remarkable.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. Leans in slightly with genuine recognition. Calm delivery with a gentle emphasis on 'breadth'—she's noticing something specific he did well. Not rushing to the compliment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。海運時代の、本気で、絶対、船員、絶対、生活、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I spent a lot of time on sailors' lives during the shipping era—that research was crucial to understanding the period.
lines.style: Focused, deliberate. Small nod in the voice, as if confirming his own investment in that section. Quiet pride without boasting. Each phrase lands with intention.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦前の、本気で、絶対、楽団、絶対、活動、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And your treatment of prewar orchestral life—that was really engaging to see covered.
lines.style: Open appreciation, conversational but attentive. Slight warmth on 'engaging'—she's noticing his unusual choice of topic. Steady eye contact in the voice, genuinely interested in what he chose to study.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。映画監督の、本気で、絶対、黒澤、絶対、明、絶対、作品、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I examined Kurosawa Akira's films quite extensively—his works were essential to that particular argument.
lines.style: Steady, assured. Matter-of-fact about his own thoroughness without self-promotion. Small breath before naming Kurosawa, as if marking an important reference. Grounded, scholarly tone.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher

lines.style: Appreciative, reflective pause before his name. Genuine recognition—she's marking a scholarly choice that impressed her. Warm but professional. The tone of a teacher who notices when a student goes beyond the obvious.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。歴史的な、本気で、絶対、真正面、絶対、からの議論、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I tried to approach the historical debates directly and comprehensively—that framework shaped everything.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Modest but not uncertain. A slight emphasis on 'directly'—he's proud of his analytical honesty. Grateful tone wrapping around genuine intellectual confidence. The close of a satisfying conversation.
